title: Crimson Eclipse Sorceress
description: A surreal fantasy scene features a tall silhouetted woman in a flowing black dress with arms outstretched beneath a glowing red moon. Below her swirls a massive vortex of red, green, and purple, with a large green lizard in the foreground and a starry night sky with strange runes filling the upper portion.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a tall silhouetted woman in a long flowing black dress standing with arms outstretched under a massive blood-red moon in a starry sky. A swirling cosmic vortex of red green and purple energy flows beneath her. A large detailed green lizard sits in the right foreground. Strange glowing runes and text cover the top portion of the image. Mystical night landscape with rolling hills below, vibrant yet dark color palette.
